# tenarium_tenant_template (Resource)

A tenant template presets new tenants (`tenarium_tenant.template`): plan, add-ons, region, labels, settings, features, limits, branding and custom roles. Values set on the tenant win; maps are merged and template settings are the base the tenant's settings are merged into. Tenants keep no link to the template, so changing or deleting it does not affect existing tenants. Managing templates needs `plans:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant_template" "startup" {
  id          = "startup"
  name        = "Startup"
  description = "Defaults for self-serve startups"
  plan        = tenarium_plan.pro.id
  add_ons     = [tenarium_plan.extra_seats.id]
  region      = "eu"
  labels      = { segment = "startup" }
  settings    = jsonencode({ onboarding = { checklist = true } })
  features    = { beta = true }
  limits      = { members = 10 }

  branding = {
    primary_color = "#1a2b3c"
  }

  # Custom roles created in every new tenant.
  roles = [{
    name        = "billing"
    description = "Manages billing contacts"
    actions     = ["tenants:read", "usage:read"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Template identifier (1-63 lowercase letters, digits or `-`). Changing it replaces the template.
- `name` (String) Display name of the template.

### Optional

- `add_ons` (Set of String) Add-on plan IDs of new tenants.
- `branding` (Attributes) Branding of new tenants. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding))
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `features` (Map of Boolean) Feature overrides of new tenants.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of new tenants.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Limit overrides of new tenants.
- `plan` (String) Plan of new tenants.
- `region` (String) Region of new tenants.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Custom roles created in new tenants. The caller creating a tenant from the template must be allowed every action of these roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `settings` (String) Settings of new tenants as a JSON object string, typically built with `jsonencode()`.

<a id="nestedatt--branding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding`

Optional:

- `accent_color` (String) Accent color as `#rrggbb`.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown instead of the tenant name.
- `icon_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the icon (favicon).
- `logo_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the logo.
- `primary_color` (String) Primary color as `#rrggbb`.
- `support_email` (String) Support email address.
- `support_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the support site.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Action patterns the role grants, e.g. `members:read` or `webhooks:*`.
- `name` (String) Lowercase role identifier; must not be a built-in role.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_tenant_template.startup startup
```
